regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I do hope you are well - and by this time able to smile at your poor inter- national enemies: in so many cases perverters of justice. and truth. Poor enemies! because in sad part materialistic - atheistic - little better than fools. I received your kind favor through Sister Mary Clarissa of the Guardian Angel Convent. This was several weeks ago it seems, to, me and I surely want/thank you for your generosity. I wanted to wright you a worth-while letter and finally To-day for the first time in several months am I "out of the woods" with my urgent letters. Thanks be to God for everything. Sister told me of your said enemies, again trying to make trouble for you, and asked for prayers for your guidance. Of course I am always glad to hear of you and get such reques. I know you have need of prayers. Who in tis world don't need them ? And this, I might say especially for one whose abilities and whose work brings him in contact with so many teptations and such opposition as does yours. I know too that you do much for the community that men know little or nothing about - often are lothe to acknowledge, or to belive. However, dear Doctor Koch: I have been wondering if there is mt something else that our dear Lord may be expecting to see you do for Him; viz, more earnestness in providing for the "insurence of your own soul's salvation". Charity is always good; always to be commended and fostered. But after all, rightly ordered charity begins at home. To my mind that means it should begin right in one's own heart - to be practical, in my own soul.
